moments.text: Infrared view looking down on rippled sea, cyan box at centre. A small bright spot drifts from upper left to just above the box.
The box shrinks to a small reticle. The spot, a bright point with a thin vertical tail below, sits upper right and drifts down beside it.
The reticle opens to a plain crosshair. The spot circles down below the crosshair to its left side; an orange marker blinks around it.
A small box returns at the crosshair; the spot wanders just below and left of it, never far from centre.
The spot moves into the box and stays there, the orange marker flashing over it, until the clip ends.

notes: White bars on the left and right edges are not cropped (crop null).
